methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was independently re-verified on 2026-06-13 by fetching each provider's own live pricing page; only providers whose plans could be confirmed on the real source page are retained. Per-editor/per-user prices carry the per-seat USD figure with a note and billingModel per_seat, while flat single-account plans use billingModel flat. Quote-only enterprise tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd null. Providers whose official pages could not be loaded (Adobe Creative Cloud and Adobe Express timed out; Canva returned HTTP 403; Affinity rendered client-side with no readable pricing) were dropped rather than retained on third-party corroboration. Minutes/calls/overage fields are null for this vertical.

vendors.name: Figma
vendors.provenance: https://www.figma.com/pricing/ (official pricing page, fetched and confirmed 2026-06-13). Figma bills per seat by seat type (Full / Dev / Collab); the Full-seat price is recorded as the plan price with other seat types noted.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Free tier: unlimited drafts, UI kits and templates, up to 150 AI credits/day (up to 500/mo); limited collaborative files. Unlimited viewers.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Full seat $16/editor/mo (Dev seat $12/mo, Collab seat $3/mo); monthly or annual billing. Full seat includes 3,000 AI credits/mo (Dev/Collab 500/mo). Viewers free.

plans.name: Organization
plans.notes: Annual billing only. Full seat $55/editor/mo (Dev $25/mo, Collab $5/mo); Full seat 3,500 AI credits/mo (Dev/Collab 500/mo).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Annual billing only. Full seat $90/editor/mo (Dev $35/mo, Collab $5/mo); Full seat 4,250 AI credits/mo (Dev/Collab 500/mo).

limits: Free: limited number of collaborative files

vendors.name: Sketch
vendors.provenance: https://www.sketch.com/pricing/ (official pricing page, fetched and confirmed 2026-06-13). Subscription tiers are per-editor billed yearly; a one-time Mac-only license is also offered.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $12/editor/mo billed yearly ($144/editor/yr); real-time collaboration, unlimited documents, unlimited free viewers, document version history and free developer handoff.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: $24/editor/mo billed yearly ($288/editor/yr); everything in Standard plus Single Sign-On (SSO), project archiving and permission groups.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $44/editor/mo billed yearly ($528/editor/yr); everything in Professional plus SCIM provisioning, BYOK encryption, dedicated support and custom reviews/terms.

plans.name: Mac-only License
plans.notes: One-time purchase: $120 per seat including one year of updates. Native Mac app for design/prototype/illustrate with offline work and local saving; excludes collaboration, online sharing and iOS preview. monthlyUsd is null because there is no monthly price.

plans.name: Private Cloud
plans.notes: Quote-only ('Contact for pricing'): everything in Professional plus a private cloud environment, choice of hosting locations, unlimited Workspaces, SCIM provisioning and BYOK encryption; monthlyUsd null.

vendors.name: Framer
vendors.provenance: https://www.framer.com/pricing/ (official pricing page, fetched and confirmed 2026-06-13). Site plans are flat per-site/month (annual billing shown); editor seats are billed separately.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 10 CMS collections, 1,000 pages, up to three editors; no custom domain (framer.website subdomain only).

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: $10/site/mo (annual billing); free custom domain, AI design tools, hosting, built-in SEO, 30 pages, 2 CMS collections, 50 GB/mo bandwidth. Extra editors $20/mo each.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $30/site/mo (annual billing); 150 pages, 10 CMS collections, 100 GB bandwidth (expandable via add-ons), staging and instant rollback, roles/permissions. Extra editors $20/mo each.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only ('Custom'): custom limits, unlimited editors, enterprise-grade security, uptime guarantee, SCIM and SSO; no public price, so monthlyUsd is null.

vendors.name: Penpot
vendors.provenance: https://penpot.app/pricing (official pricing page, fetched and confirmed 2026-06-13). Open-source design tool; Cloud paid tiers are per-user/month.

plans.name: Professional (Free)
plans.notes: Free: up to 8 team members, unlimited viewers, 10 GB storage, 7-day version history and deleted-file recovery, fully open-source.

plans.name: Unlimited
plans.notes: $7/user/mo, capped at $175/mo maximum per organization; 25 GB storage, 30-day version history, early feature access and a 50% Penpot-events discount.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $25/user/mo, starting at $950/mo; unlimited storage, 180-day version history, centralized admin console, advanced permissions, SSO, plugins allowlist and audit logs.

plans.name: Private Server
plans.notes: $50,000/year for dedicated private infrastructure, enterprise SSO, SCIM role assignment, choice of hosting region and IP whitelisting; priced annually so monthlyUsd is null.
